## Summary
Build the weak areas panel that auto-identifies concepts where p_mastery < 0.5 and provides a one-click drill button to launch a targeted practice session for each weak area.

## User story
As a student, I want to see my weakest concepts highlighted automatically with a one-click practice option, so that I can focus my study time on areas that need the most improvement.

## Why this matters
Students often don't know what they don't know. Auto-identifying weak areas removes the cognitive burden of self-assessment and lowers the friction to targeted practice. The one-click drill is the shortest path from "I'm weak here" to "I'm practicing here."

## Acceptance criteria
- [ ] Weak areas panel shows concepts where p_mastery < 0.5, sorted ascending by p_mastery
- [ ] Each weak area card displays: concept name, USMLE system, p_mastery, review count
- [ ] One-click "Drill" button creates a practice session filtered to that concept
- [ ] Drill launches a practice session using PracticeSessionService (from E08-S05 or standalone)
- [ ] Empty state: encouraging message when no concepts are below 0.5 threshold
- [ ] Weak areas grouped by USMLE system for visual organization
- [ ] Maximum 20 weak areas displayed (sorted by lowest p_mastery first)
- [ ] Queries concept_mastery table with B-tree index on (student_id, p_mastery)

## Canonical decisions in play

## Schema changes
```sql
-- Index for efficient weak area queries
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_concept_mastery_weak_areas
  ON public.concept_mastery (student_id, p_mastery ASC)
  WHERE p_mastery < 0.5;

-- After adding: pnpm db:types to regenerate database.generated.ts
```

## API contract
```
Weak areas are fetched client-side via Supabase client (RLS-scoped):
  supabase
    .from('concept_mastery')
    .select('*, subconcepts(name, usmle_system)')
    .eq('student_id', userId)
    .lt('p_mastery', 0.5)
    .order('p_mastery', { ascending: true })
    .limit(20)

Drill button calls: POST /api/practice/session (from E08-S05)
  with filters: { concept_id: weakArea.concept_id }
```

## Code patterns to follow
```typescript
// features/mastery-tracking/hooks/useWeakAreas.ts
import { createBrowserClient } from '@journey/db/client';
import { useEffect, useState } from 'react';
import type { Row } from '@journey/db/client';

type ConceptMastery = Row<'concept_mastery'>;

const WEAK_THRESHOLD = 0.5;
const MAX_WEAK_AREAS = 20;

export function useWeakAreas(studentId: string) {
  const [weakAreas, setWeakAreas] = useState<ConceptMastery[]>([]);
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(true);

  useEffect(() => {
    const supabase = createBrowserClient();
    supabase
      .from('concept_mastery')
      .select('*, subconcepts(name, usmle_system)')
      .eq('student_id', studentId)
      .lt('p_mastery', WEAK_THRESHOLD)
      .order('p_mastery', { ascending: true })
      .limit(MAX_WEAK_AREAS)
      .then(({ data }) => {
        setWeakAreas(data ?? []);
        setLoading(false);
      });
  }, [studentId]);

  return { weakAreas, loading, hasWeakAreas: weakAreas.length > 0 };
}

// features/mastery-tracking/components/WeakAreaCard.tsx (molecule — pure props)
interface WeakAreaCardProps {
  conceptName: string;
  usmleSystem: string;
  pMastery: number;
  reviewCount: number;
  onDrill: () => void;
}

export function WeakAreaCard({ conceptName, usmleSystem, pMastery, reviewCount, onDrill }: WeakAreaCardProps) {
  return (
    <div data-testid="weak-area-card">
      <h3>{conceptName}</h3>
      <span>{usmleSystem}</span>
      <span>Mastery: {(pMastery * 100).toFixed(0)}%</span>
      <span>Reviews: {reviewCount}</span>
      <button onClick={onDrill}>Drill</button>
    </div>
  );
}
```

## Automated tests (Playwright — runs during /validate)
```typescript
// tests/E08/E08-S06.ui.test.ts
import { test, expect } from '@playwright/test';

test('Weak areas panel shows concepts below 0.5 mastery', async ({ page }) => {
  await loginAsStudent(page);
  await page.goto('/mastery');
  await expect(page.locator('[data-testid="weak-areas-panel"]')).toBeVisible();
});

test('Weak area card shows concept name and mastery percentage', async ({ page }) => {
  await loginAsStudentWithWeakAreas(page);
  await page.goto('/mastery');
  const card = page.locator('[data-testid="weak-area-card"]').first();
  await expect(card).toBeVisible();
  await expect(card.getByText(/%/)).toBeVisible();
});

test('Drill button navigates to practice session', async ({ page }) => {
  await loginAsStudentWithWeakAreas(page);
  await page.goto('/mastery');
  await page.locator('[data-testid="weak-area-card"]').first()
    .getByRole('button', { name: /drill/i }).click();
  await page.waitForURL('**/practice/**');
});

test('Empty state shows encouraging message when no weak areas', async ({ page }) => {
  await loginAsStudentWithNoWeakAreas(page);
  await page.goto('/mastery');
  await expect(page.getByText(/no weak areas|looking strong/i)).toBeVisible();
});
```
